modules.name: RaffleFactory deployment and registry
modules.role: Deploys the fixed Raffle implementation, creates ERC-1167 clones, initializes and registers them, and deposits each sponsor-selected prize (L65-L92, L97-L148).

modules.name: Raffle lifecycle, escrow, and accounting
modules.role: Holds clone configuration and lifecycle state, sells range tickets, coordinates the draw/refund branches, allocates quote-token liabilities, and releases NFT or quote-token claims (L52-L142, L176-L430, L509-L567).

modules.name: Transferable range-ticket ledger
modules.role: Raffle inherits ERC721 and overrides its update hook to screen ticket destinations; inherited ownership, balance, approval, transfer, and metadata entrypoints remain externally reachable (Raffle.sol:L28, L477-L502; ERC721.sol:L19-L34, L44-L136).

modules.name: Chainlink VRF direct-funding adapter
modules.role: Quotes and requests one native-funded random word, authenticates the wrapper callback, and maps an accepted word to a winning entry and outcome (Raffle.sol:L240-L272, L436-L448, L509-L524; VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L76-L107).

modules.name: Public protocol interfaces
modules.role: Defines lifecycle types, creation/initialization parameters, events, errors, state-changing calls, views, and generated-getter ABIs for the two deployed contracts (IRaffle.sol:L17-L54, L303-L520; IRaffleFactory.sol:L11-L26, L99-L149).

modules.name: Fixed economics, timing, and execution bounds
modules.role: Defines basis-point rates, entry price, token decimals, refund batch bound, sale/draw timeouts, and VRF callback parameters consumed by both contracts (L10-L42).

modules.name: External-asset, clone, and call guards
modules.role: Supplies ERC-20 call wrappers, minimal-proxy creation, and the shared storage guard used by state-changing entrypoints (SafeERC20.sol:L30-L47, L176-L244; Clones.sol:L23-L62; ReentrancyGuard.sol:L35-L72, L94-L105).

modules.name: Contract build surface
modules.role: Builds the same Solidity source with Hardhat and Foundry using solc 0.8.36, Cancun, optimizer enabled, and 200 runs (package.json:L9-L11, L27-L30; foundry.toml:L1-L14; hardhat.config.ts:L14-L35).

actors.name: Factory deployer / deployment tooling
actors.basis: Chooses the canonical quote token, wrapper, and treasury passed to the constructor; the source says tooling must verify official USDC identity (RaffleFactory.sol:L58-L65).

actors.name: Canonical RaffleFactory contract
actors.basis: It is the only accepted initializer and required prize-deposit operator (Raffle.sol:L176-L179, L421-L424); its creation flow supplies both (RaffleFactory.sol:L105-L128).

actors.name: Sponsor / raffle creator
actors.basis: Any caller may supply creation parameters and prize custody (RaffleFactory.sol:L97-L128); the stored sponsor has one scoped empty-raffle transition path (Raffle.sol:L279-L284).

actors.name: Buyer / permissionless caller / keeper
actors.basis: Any address can buy, request a draw, settle, or trigger releases subject to function-local conditions (Raffle.sol:L209-L250, L304-L306, L375-L407).

actors.name: Ticket owner or approved ticket operator
actors.basis: Owners hold bearer claims and may approve or transfer them through inherited ERC-721 entrypoints (IRaffle.sol:L10-L15; ERC721.sol:L92-L136); redemption/refund checks current ownership (Raffle.sol:L320-L325, L357-L365).

actors.name: Configured quote-token contract
actors.basis: The interface declares canonical, six-decimal, standard, non-rebasing, fee-free semantics (IRaffle.sol:L12-L15); the factory checks deployed code and six decimals (RaffleFactory.sol:L66-L78).

actors.name: Sponsor-selected prize ERC-721 contract
actors.basis: The sponsor chooses it and the factory checks code and ERC-721 interface support (RaffleFactory.sol:L97-L104, L154-L178); the interface assumes an honest standards-compliant ERC-721 (IRaffle.sol:L12-L15).

actors.name: Configured Chainlink VRF wrapper
actors.basis: The deployer fixes it in the factory (RaffleFactory.sol:L65-L67, L85-L91), and the inherited callback gateway accepts only that address (VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L101-L106).

actors.name: Sponsor recipient and protocol treasury
actors.basis: They are immutable payout destinations supplied at deployment/creation (RaffleFactory.sol:L64-L68, L97-L104); releases target them without granting call authority (Raffle.sol:L375-L406).

actors.name: ERC-721 ticket receiver contract
actors.basis: Safe ticket mint/transfer can invoke receiver code after the ownership update (Raffle.sol:L235; ERC721.sol:L127-L136, L279-L290).

actors.name: Block timestamp environment
actors.basis: Sale, request, callback, and refund eligibility read block.timestamp (Raffle.sol:L216, L242-L246, L282-L291, L512; RaffleFactory.sol:L99-L104).

state.name: Factory fixed configuration: quoteToken, vrfWrapper, protocolTreasury, raffleImplementation, callbackGasLimit, requestConfirmations
writtenBy: RaffleFactory constructor fixes addresses and deploys implementation (L65-L92); constants bind to RaffleConstants (L24-L28).

state.name: Factory registry: raffleCount, raffleById, idByRaffle, isRaffle
writtenBy: createRaffle increments and records all four registry values (L105-L125).

state.name: Raffle fixed implementation configuration: factory, quoteToken, wrapper, LINK token, protocol constants
writtenBy: Raffle constructor sets factory and quoteToken (Raffle.sol:L155-L164); inherited constructor derives LINK and stores wrapper (VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L40-L47); constants bind at Raffle.sol:L43-L50.

state.name: Per-raffle configuration: sponsor, sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, prizeToken, prizeTokenId, raffleId, reserveEntries, endTime
writtenBy: initialize writes the complete clone configuration once (L176-L205).

state.name: Lifecycle state: status, initialized, settlementComplete, winnerRedeemed, prizeClaimed
Entry and ticket-range accounting: totalEntries, ticketCount, _ticketRanges
writtenBy: buyEntries assigns the next inclusive range and advances both counters (L226-L233).

state.name: Ticket ownership and approvals: _owners, _balances, _tokenApprovals, _operatorApprovals
writtenBy: ERC721._update writes owners/balances and clears approval (L216-L242)
Raffle routes mint, transfer, and burn through its override then super._update (Raffle.sol:L497-L502).

state.name: Quote-token liability buckets: unsettledPot, remainingRefundLiability, winnerProceeds, sponsorProceeds, protocolFees
writtenBy: enableRefunds moves the pot to refund liability (L296-L299)
_settleWinningTicket replaces the pot with terminal allocations (L539-L555)
redeem/release calls zero each paid bucket (L339-L342, L375-L390).

state.name: Draw coordination: vrfRequestId, drawRequestedAt, _requestInFlight
writtenBy: requestDraw sets the timestamp and in-flight flag around the wrapper call, then persists the request ID and clears the flag (L252-L260).

state.name: Resolved result: resolvedAt, winningEntry, winningTicketId, winnerRecipient
Guard word at the fixed ReentrancyGuard storage slot
writtenBy: Inherited nonReentrant entry/exit writes ENTERED then NOT_ENTERED (L69-L72, L94-L105); the modifier is attached to RaffleFactory.createRaffle (RaffleFactory.sol:L97) and the Raffle state-changing paths at Raffle.sol:L209-L212, L240, L276, L304, L309, L349, L375, L385, L395.

state.name: Raffle native-token balance
writtenBy: requestDraw is payable, funds the wrapper, and may refund excess (Raffle.sol:L240-L270); direct receive always reverts (Raffle.sol:L170-L173).

state.name: Raffle quote-token custody balance in the configured token
writtenBy: buyEntries pulls grossAmount from the buyer (L223-L224); redemption, refunds, and releases transfer quote token out through _transferQuote (L339-L342, L367-L390, L564-L567).

state.name: Escrowed prize ownership in the configured ERC-721
writtenBy: Factory safe-transfers the configured prize into the clone and verifies ownership/state (RaffleFactory.sol:L127-L134); winner redemption or sponsor-prize release transfers it out and verifies the recipient (Raffle.sol:L329-L337, L395-L406).

candidates.name: RaffleFactory.createRaffle
candidates.why: Validates untrusted creation parameters, advances the registry, deploys and initializes a clone, calls a sponsor-selected NFT, and verifies custody/state (L97-L147).

candidates.name: Raffle.requestDraw
candidates.why: Coordinates lifecycle/timestamps, a wrapper price query and paid request, request-ID persistence, a temporary flag, and native excess return (L240-L272).

candidates.name: Raffle.buyEntries
candidates.why: Validates buyer-selected quantity/recipient, pulls quote token, advances global ranges and liabilities, and safely mints a ticket (L209-L236).

candidates.name: Raffle.fulfillRandomWords
candidates.why: Consumes authenticated callback data, evaluates request/status/time gates, derives the selected entry, and fixes the terminal outcome (L509-L523).

candidates.name: Raffle.redeemWinningTicket
candidates.why: Combines optional settlement, current-owner authorization, ticket burn, claim-state writes, and NFT or quote-token delivery (L309-L345).

candidates.name: Raffle.enableRefunds
candidates.why: Branches on lifecycle, sold-entry count, sponsor identity, and two deadlines before moving the entire pot into refund liability (L276-L300).

candidates.name: Raffle.refundTickets
candidates.why: Processes a bounded caller-selected ticket batch, checks ownership and ranges, burns claims, reduces aggregate liability, and pays quote token (L349-L371).

candidates.name: Raffle._settleWinningTicket
candidates.why: Validates the winning range and atomically transforms the unsettled pot into winner, sponsor, and protocol allocations (L533-L557).

candidates.name: Raffle.onERC721Received
candidates.why: Authenticates all fields of the factory-mediated prize callback and performs the AwaitingPrize-to-Active transition (L416-L430).

candidates.name: Raffle.initialize
candidates.why: Enforces one-time factory access, screens configuration destinations, and establishes all clone-specific configuration and initial status (L176-L205).

candidates.name: Raffle._update
candidates.why: Intercepts every ticket mint, transfer, and burn, screens nonzero destinations, then delegates ownership/approval mutation to ERC721 (L497-L502; ERC721.sol:L216-L244).

candidates.name: VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.rawFulfillRandomWords
candidates.why: Forms the external wrapper authentication boundary and dispatches accepted request data into Raffle.fulfillRandomWords (L101-L107; Raffle.sol:L509-L524).

candidates.name: Raffle.releaseSponsorPrize
candidates.why: Checks terminal/refund state and one-time prize disposition before external NFT delivery and post-transfer ownership verification (L395-L406).

candidates.name: RaffleFactory._validateCreateParams
candidates.why: Screens sponsor-selected token/recipient destinations, queries ERC-165 support across success/failure paths, and enforces a nonzero reserve (L154-L178).

candidates.name: Raffle._isProtocolDestination
candidates.why: Centralizes destination classification across local addresses, implementation identity, and a conditional external registry lookup (L593-L604).

candidates.name: Raffle._transferQuote
candidates.why: Central payout helper screens the destination then dispatches the configured quote-token transfer used by four claim paths (L564-L567; L342, L369, L380, L390).

candidates.name: ERC721.transferFrom
candidates.why: Checks transfer authorization and ownership through the inherited ledger while dynamically dispatching to Raffle._update (L114-L125; Raffle.sol:L497-L502).

candidates.name: ERC721.safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes)
candidates.why: Adds an external recipient-acceptance call after the ticket transfer path (L132-L136), so analysis must follow both the inherited transfer and receiver dispatch.

candidates.name: Raffle._requireWinningTicket
candidates.why: Maps the selected entry to a caller-supplied historical range and is the proof gate relied on by terminal allocation (L579-L584; L538).

candidates.name: Raffle.releaseSponsorProceeds
candidates.why: Consumes the complete sponsor liability, zeroes it before the centralized external quote-token payment, and records release (L375-L381).

candidates.name: Raffle.releaseProtocolFees
candidates.why: Consumes the complete protocol liability, zeroes it before the centralized external quote-token payment, and records release (L385-L391).

candidates.name: RaffleFactory.constructor
candidates.why: Establishes all deployment trust anchors, queries quote-token metadata, screens the treasury, and deploys the locked implementation (L65-L92).

candidates.name: Raffle.constructor
candidates.why: Establishes implementation-baked factory/token/wrapper configuration and locks the implementation's own initialization state (L155-L166).

candidates.name: ReentrancyGuard.nonReentrant path
candidates.why: A single fixed storage word brackets each protected factory/raffle state-changing entrypoint and therefore couples their nested-call behavior (L69-L72, L94-L105).
